excerpt.zh: [beholder_planet.GetName]上的金字塔已不复存在，原地留下了一个巨大的空洞。当地的未开智生物满脸困惑地站在空洞的峭壁边上。
excerpt.en: The Monolith on [beholder_planet.GetName] has vanished, leaving a giant crater in its wake. The pre-sapient inhabitants line the precipice, seemingly confused.
